provider.description: Provider token of the integration reporting its own trouble.

status.description: The provider status code observed (403 discloses to team operators; 429 to system operators).

endpointId.description: The link endpoint whose deliveries stall (429: only THAT endpoint's queue backs off).

retryable.description: True when a later attempt may succeed (429 backoff); false when a human must fix something (403).

team.description: Team slug whose operators the disclosure addresses (optional; the kernel routes to that team's channel when set).
